data.sync_errors:
MainWP Child plugin not detected or could not be reached! Ensure the MainWP Child plugin is installed and activated on the child site, and there are no security rules blocking requests. If you continue experiencing this issue, check the MainWP Community for help.

Dashboard outbound IP (allowlist this): Unavailable. Check Info → Server for Public Dashboard IP, or ask your host.

User-Agent MainWP sends: Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; MainWP/6.4.1; +http://mainwp.com)

Cloudflare/proxy edge IP (do not allowlist this as the Dashboard IP): 172.20.0.4

Child / HTTP response

Status: 400 (Bad Request)

Headers:
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
server: Apache/2.4.69 (Debian)
content-type: text/html; charset=UTF-8

Body: the site returned text instead of the MainWP response. Ask the host to check the registration request to wp-admin/admin-ajax.php.
Excerpt: 0

If the child site is behind Cloudflare or another WAF, allow this User-Agent there. Then reinstall or reactivate MainWP Child only if that does not resolve it.
